concern: The original replication contained 10 deaths at zero follow-up and yielded stronger topology metrics.
resolution_or_reporting_boundary: Corrected positive-follow-up cohort is primary; original 14,457/546 result is audit-only.

concern: aVL first difference is strongly coupled to a local Q--S-span proxy that is not clinical global QRS duration.
resolution_or_reporting_boundary: Span-adjusted estimates and morphology correlations are reported; no independent aVL or fully duration-independent claim.

concern: Discovery was availability-restricted rather than a random CODE sample.
resolution_or_reporting_boundary: Exact restriction (12,964 unavailable index waveforms; 22 missing outcomes) is disclosed; no new shards were admitted.

concern: Full adjustment weakens Pearson/rank agreement relative to unadjusted analyses.
resolution_or_reporting_boundary: All three adjustment specifications and bootstrap intervals are reported; inference uses full adjustment.

concern: Normal-ECG subgroups have few events and no Bonferroni-significant features.
resolution_or_reporting_boundary: Reported as null and underpowered; no normal-population claim.

concern: Some adjustment covariates violate proportional hazards even though no feature term crosses the 24-test threshold.
resolution_or_reporting_boundary: Feature-specific tests are the stated result; model-wide PH perfection is not claimed.

concern: SaMi-Trop outcomes were previously inspected and three effects oppose discovery.
resolution_or_reporting_boundary: SaMi-Trop is supportive disease-specific generalization only; opposing effects are enumerated.

concern: The feature named rs_diff_2 is the frozen absolute change in absolute first differences, not a signed conventional second derivative.
resolution_or_reporting_boundary: The manuscript gives the exact operational definition; the feature was not renamed or redefined after discovery.

concern: The frozen score sums correlated marginal coefficients and has a small corrected-replication C-index increment.
resolution_or_reporting_boundary: Presented as representation-transfer evidence, not an optimized, calibrated, or clinically useful prediction model.

concern: Morphology waveform review is stratified and finite rather than a blinded clinical annotation study.
resolution_or_reporting_boundary: Used as extraction QC together with cohort-scale duration correlations and sensitivity models; no mechanistic interpretation.
